title: The Big 4 departments, explained with Ledger in under 2 minutes
summary: One juice company meets audit, tax, consulting, risk and deals at a Big 4 firm, then learns why the same firm cannot audit it and install its systems, ending on a five-row board with each firm's own real division names and logos

beats.voice: The Big 4 departments, explained with Ledger in under 2 minutes
beats.visual: Title card on steps: the four official logos on white chips pop in one by one (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG) as the voice reaches the title; Ledger in a suit waves in the middle

beats.label: intro
beats.voice: First, the Big 4 are Deloitte, PwC, EY and KPMG, and each one sells five kinds of work
beats.visual: Four office towers rise left to right; each logo chip lands on its tower as its name is said; five labelled doors open at the base of each tower at the word five

beats.label: intro
beats.voice: So let's imagine one client, a juice company called Sunny Press, and follow its year
beats.visual: A juice stand with an orange logo slides in; a calendar page flips through four seasons; Ledger as the owner holds a juice bottle

beats.voice: Then the auditors check the accounts of Sunny Press and sign an audit opinion saying the numbers are fair
beats.visual: Ledger auditor in a suit and glasses ticks rows on a ledger book at the word check; a document labelled AUDIT OPINION slides out and a green stamp lands on it at the word sign

beats.label: dept
beats.voice: Next, the tax team prepares the returns and advises on tax planning in each country
beats.visual: Ledger tax adviser at a desk with a calculator; a form labelled TAX RETURN gets a stamp at the word prepares; a small map with two flags lights up at the words each country

beats.label: dept
beats.voice: After that, the consulting team installs a new sales system, so every order is tracked
beats.visual: Ledger consultant in a hoodie plugs a laptop into a big dashboard at the word installs; orders as small boxes flow into the dashboard at the words every order

beats.label: dept
beats.voice: Now the risk team tests how fraud, cyberattacks or weak controls could cost the company money
beats.visual: Ledger risk adviser holds a clipboard at the till; a small red bug icon, a padlock and a loose cash box appear one by one at the words fraud, cyberattacks and weak controls; a risk report with a red-amber-green list slides out

beats.label: dept
beats.voice: Then Sunny Press wants to buy a smaller juice brand, so the deals team investigates it and writes a due diligence report

beats.voice: But here is the catch, because the same firm cannot do all of this for one client

beats.label: compare

caption:
What do the Big 4 actually do all day?

Deloitte, PwC, EY and KPMG each sell five similar kinds of work. Audit checks the accounts and gives an audit opinion, tax prepares returns and advises on tax planning, consulting installs systems that change how a business runs, risk tests where the company could lose money, and deals investigates a company before it is bought

But one firm cannot do everything for one client, because an auditor must stay independent and must not audit its own work

Which of these five departments would you want to see from the inside?
